statement.p: Suppose you need to plot the equation y=-4.25\text{.} Since the equation is in y= form, you decide to make a table of points. Fill out some points for this table.

solution.p: We can use whatever values for x that we like, as long as they are all different. The equation tells us the y-value has to be -4.25 each time.
Now that we have a table, we could use its values to assist with plotting the line.
